convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load the 'JMASlope' custom indicator which is not a built-in MT5 indicator. Also includes <TradeAlgorithms.mqh> external library for trade execution logic (BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen), requiring manual recreation of both the custom indicator logic and the trading library functions.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA trades

other_exits: In breakdown mode: close long when JMASlope goes negative, close short when JMASlope goes positive. In twist mode: close long when JMASlope slope turns negative, close short when JMASlope slope turns positive.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values are treated as fixed lot size (e.g. -0.1 means 0.1 lots), positive values are treated as share/fraction of deposit. Logic handled inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh library.

custom_logic_notes: Two distinct entry modes controlled by AlgMode enum: (1) 'breakdown' mode - enters when JMASlope crosses zero (Value[1]>0 and Value[0]<=0 for buy, Value[1]<0 and Value[0]>=0 for sell); (2) 'twist' mode - enters on direction change of JMASlope slope (Value[1]<Value[2] and Value[0]>Value[1] for buy, Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<Value[1] for sell). SignalBar=0 allows intrabar recalculation without waiting for new bar. When CopyBuffer fails, Recount is set true to retry on next tick. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans gate whether each trade direction is permitted at all. Applied_price_ enum defines 12 custom price types beyond standard MT5 prices, passed to JMASlope indicator.
python_conversion_notes: The JMASlope custom indicator must be reimplemented or pre-computed since it is loaded via iCustom. The JMA (Jurik Moving Average) Slope algorithm is proprietary and not trivially reproducible - consider using a Python JMA implementation or pre-computing indicator values from MT5. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles all trade execution including position sizing logic (negative MM=lot, positive MM=deposit fraction), position closing, and signal time tracking - this must be fully reverse-engineered. The Applied_price_ enum with 12 custom price types (Simpl, Quarter, TrendFollow, Demark) needs custom price calculation functions. Entry signals are evaluated on completed bars (SignalBar=1 default) but can operate on current bar (SignalBar=0) with new-bar guard bypassed.
